tables.name: gmail_server_resume_bindings
tables.owner_query: SELECT t.rowid AS rid,a.id AS account_id,t.tenant_id FROM gmail_server_resume_bindings t JOIN accounts a ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id
tables.key_transition: Preserve exact original server OAuth connection/epoch and run binding; never select helper or replacement mailbox.
tables.verification: Exact schema; row count; unique existing owner; declared FK integrity and cross-owner FK check
tables.on_failure: Stop dry run; quarantine unresolved ownership, never infer owner from email or table name.
